moments.text: The phone swings up toward the trees; motion blur turns two lights above them into short red streaks.
Wide view of a backyard: tall trees against pale sky, fence and lawn below. Two small orange lights, one above the other, drift slowly left.
The camera zooms in on the two orange-red lights, one above the other, each glowing with a brighter centre against the sky.
Both lights hang just above the treetops beside a trunk; the upper one slips behind leaves at 0:17.5, the lower one at 0:20.
The camera wanders through dark foliage; the lights are mostly hidden, glimpsed only as faint red dots or streaks between branches.
A blurred house wall with a bright light on it fills the left foreground; two small red dots still show above the trees at 0:41-0:43.
The camera drops to the fence, lawn and driveway, and the clip ends pointing at the ground.

notes: Missing stored crop: upright 606 px strip inside black side bars (content crop 606:1080:656:0); auto cropdetect fails on the dark frames, so assets.crop should be set by hand.
